experiences.cancellationPolicyDesc: Any experience can be canceled and fully refunded within 24 hours of purchase, or at least 7 days before the experience starts.
experiences.personRequirementsDesc: Up to 10 persons ages 4 and up can attend. Parents may also bring children under 2 years of age.
experiences.longDescription:
PRIVATE TUK-TUK TOUR — tailored around you.

07:30 – Our guide will meet you at the agreed pickup point and begin the tour in a comfortable, 100% electric tuk-tuk. The route includes the sanctuary, coastal viewpoints and medieval streets — stops and timing are adapted to your pace and interests.

Lunch and short breaks are included where indicated. At the end of the day we return to the original pickup point.

This is a full-day tour; times are indicative and can be adjusted on request.
